recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Future changes to TestScript.operation.method should be handled in the FHIR Testing IG source rather than by restoring removed core TestScript files.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core TestScript issue requesting optional TestScript.setup.action.operation.method so TestScript can force HTTP POST invocation of FHIR search instead of only relying on operation defaults.
initial_application: Commit 2adf2bc16064ef00751f144ee1437455bba61b42 applied the issue with the message 'GF 19284 - added operation.method element'. Before the later resource move, source/testscript/structuredefinition-TestScript.xml contained TestScript.setup.action.operation.method as a 0..1 code with required binding to ValueSet/http-operations and a comment naming HTTP POST search support.
additional_context: Commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 removed TestScript, TestReport, and TestPlan from the active core resource list, deleted source/testscript, and added the FHIR Testing IG as an additional IG in source/fhir.ini. Current external Testing IG JSON still contains operation.method with the HTTP operations binding and includes post/POST.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch and made no core source changes because the requested TestScript behavior is outside the current FHIR core build scope.
